status: development design after inspected v1-v14; no prospective preregistration or independent confirmation
representation_scope: Exactly v9 four descriptors, v10 w1_p0.5/w1_p1, and v10 w4_p1-w1_p1. Recompute from original paired component/evidence streams and require all109 patients to reproduce stored values and originalT/R/F. Shared mathematical descriptors do not imply equal physical timescales, distributions or physiology across ITPC, automatic stages and EEGpower.
shuffle: One fixed label-free within-contiguous-segment permutation applied jointly to each aligned evidence/paired-component stream. Preserve marginal features, values, counts and every gap/channel boundary. Only adjacency and window4-minus-window1 may change. Derive RNG seed from501003 and namespace patientID. No cross-patient feature permutation or test-data donors.
anchor: Fixed T Binder/Wielek and originaluHNDI Mendeley, prior inspected-data choice explicitly disclosed; no anchor-selection gain credited to new information.
preprocessing: Independently per cohort and training fold: robust median/IQR (std/1 fallback), asinh both strong scores, tanh seven extras, least-squares projection on[1,asinh(T),asinh(uHNDI)], residual/sqrt(p). Does not prove conditional independence or full rawgain invariance.
algorithm: Bounded hierarchical pairwise ranker: score=measurement_anchor_asinh+eta*tanh(Z*(beta_shared+delta_cohort)). Equal-weight mean of within-cohort positive-negative-pair logistic losses, ridge_shared*||beta_shared||^2/2 plus local_ridge/(2C)*sum||delta_cohort||^2. Shared/private parameters learned solely on global training patients; no cross-cohort ROC pairs. Pair counts are not patient sample size.
global_split: At each originalseed/outerfold, simultaneously exclude all three cohorts' original outer-test patients from every shared learner, scaler and hyperparameter choice. Inner folds similarly concatenate only corresponding inner-train roles in all3cohorts; corresponding inner-validation patients from all3 are excluded. This is within-known-cohort holdout with pooled training, not unseen-center validation.
selection: Mean three-inner-fold arithmetic mean cohort AUC; earliest candidate within1e-12 retained, eta0first then smallereta/strongerlocalridge. Ten primaryconfigs; shared-only4uniqueeta configs. No selection on outer results.
ablations: shared_only locks all deltas0; private locks beta_shared0 and solves each cohortblock independently (same global hyperchoice); cohort_tuned_private chooses that decoupled model's config separately by owncohort innerAUC. Anchor_nonlinear uses seven train-derived functions of the two normalized strong scores only, with identical hierarchical learner. Distribution_only excludes adjacency/window4difference; shuffled uses the joint per-stream shuffle. Do not credit gain over private global selection alone as proof over independently tuned private controls.
anchor_nonlinear_features: For train-normalized t,u: tanh(t),tanh(u),tanh(t)^2,tanh(u)^2,tanh(t*u),tanh(t+u),tanh(t-u); then same per-cohort robust feature normalization/projection. Nonlinear baseline has no supplementary signal.
common_comparator_inputs: Exactly three cohort one-hot columns, two train-normalized strong scores, seven residual extras, and each cohort's interaction with the9signal columns:39columns. CohortID is known signal modality/domain, never patient diagnosis, demographic or filename as a feature. All pooled classical/recent methods see exactly this matrix and global training roles. Within classics use the same matrix restricted to owncohort and owncohort innerselection; quality-only uses component-record quality4 plus domain and interactions, no signal scores.

etmc.limit: Disclosed journalvectoradaptation, not full imagebackbone reproduction

roboss.limit: Paper objective/L-BFGS adaptation, nonconvex local solve, not officialNAG

tabpfn.limit: Official localv2; upstream exposure cannot be exhaustively audited

performance_target: Positive macro deltas vs T and originaluHNDI at everyseed, positive5-seed mean vsboth in eachcohort, positive mean macro vs measurement_anchor, private_increment, cohort_tuned_private and anchor_nonlinear_control. Report all pooled/within and recent results without hiding stronger comparators. Shared gain is developmental, not independent confirmation.
metric: Arithmetic mean outer-fold AUC then5-seedmean and equal-cohortmacro; no pooled cross-cohort/cross-fold probability AUC as primary.
environment: Isolated sklearn1.6.1/tabpfn2.0.9, SCIPY_ARRAY_API=1 before imports, Torchthreads1, local model; globaldeps unchanged. Store all source/code/package hashes, feature reproductions, global and original cohort role records, every candidate innerprediction and selected outerparameters.
novelty_limit: Candidate hierarchical information sharing for heterogenous target adapters; component regularization/MTL operations are established and not claimed unprecedented. Same label names do not establish identical clinical ascertainment or physiological scales. No guaranteed AUC gain, clinical superiority, rawgain invariance or unseen-modality generalization.
protection: Earlier completed studies/manuscript unchanged; freeze protocol/code before outcome predictions, preserve every negative result. New outcome-informed design requires new version.
